scope: Independent read-only source and recorded-test review, not independent device execution or full recovery approval

resolved_findings.previous: Legacy RkUI::CheckKey(int) hid selected RecoveryUI::CheckKey(int,bool), and old fixture reproduced incorrect one-argument shape.
resolved_findings.resolution: Obsolete RkUI and its duplicate counter were removed. Device constructs ScreenRecoveryUI directly, leaving actual platform key handling inherited. Final fixture copies the two-argument callback shape and calls through RecoveryUI* with markers. It makes no claim to execute the real platform long-press/reboot policy.
Final check says base-device-stores-ui-pointer. The real base stores the pointer; its empty destructor does not establish RAII ownership.

verified_menu.navigation: down/volume-down, up/volume-up, enter/power only invoke when visible; unmapped or hidden menu returns kNoAction
verified_menu.constructor: Device(new ScreenRecoveryUI) matches selected Device(RecoveryUI*) and inherited GetUI()

recorded_validation.host_result: pass in recorded log; reviewed assertions and result, not rerun by reviewer
recorded_validation.baseline: Old constructor and APPLY_EXT/APPLY_CACHE cause the recorded expected compilation failure
recorded_validation.android_rule_result: attempt-13 records actual ARM C++ compilation and archive creation of librecovery_ui_aosp_arm; not a recovery executable link

unsafe_upstream_paths.sd_config: sdboot.cpp151,155–160 converts nonzero fw_update into command arguments; SD config path at178 and USB at193
unsafe_upstream_paths.idblock: sdboot.cpp344 initializes bUpdateIDBlock=true; only pFile==2 clears it at354;370–373 selects firmware or partition update
unsafe_upstream_paths.limit: The four provider Android.mk files select prebuilt ARM/ARM64 .a files. This source review does not establish complete source, license terms, or exact backend behavior, and executed none of those paths.

integration_limits: The UI patch remains an opt-in source adaptation. Generic aosp_arm attempts do not show TARGET_RECOVERY_UI_LIB selection into a successful recovery link.
Static archives/CRT and host menu tests do not constitute recovery executable, recovery.img, SD boot, NAND/eMMC compatibility, framebuffer/input operation or a flashable ROM.
Raw upstream recovery contains update/format/write functionality and must not be described as read-only diagnostics.
Actual platform key policy remains inherited by source structure; the final host marker fixture does not simulate its implementation or Android UI ABI.
previous_review: pre-dispatch-fix-review.json preserves the superseded findings and hashes
